definitions.full: H3729. kephath כְּפַת verb bind ( ᵑ7 id. ; Late Hebrew כָּפַת ; Syriac form knots , twist into a knot , Arabic draw together , Assyrian [ kapâtu ] II. bring together ); — Pe`il Perfect 3masculine plural פִ֫תוּ כְּ , (W CG 224 ) Dan 3:21 they were bound. Pa`el bind: Infinitive לְכַמָּתָךְ Dan 3:20 ( ל accusative of person); Passive participle plural מְכַמְּתִין bound 3:23 ; 3:24 .
